metadata.document_title: RBI Small Finance Banks Fraud Risk Management Directions 2026

chunks.text:
These Directions are issued with a view to providing a framework for prevention, early
detection, and timely reporting of incidents of fraud by Small Finance Banks to Law
Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) and Reserve Bank of India (‘RBI’) and dissemination of
information by RBI and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
